svg.title: Latency shares for CPU-only and CPU–HPU workflows
svg.desc: Three horizontal 100 percent stacked bars in each of two side-by-side panels show AND, Add, and Mul. Each bar has both mean shares annotated beneath it: preparation at the left in blue and homomorphic computation at the right in dark orange. Both panels use identical host CPU data preparation. Original min/max marks are rotated onto the horizontal percentage axis.
